name: Marija Kovačić
bio:
Marija Kovačić's path to motorsport security was unconventional. A former detective with the Croatian police force, she specialized in organized crime and financial fraud before a chance assignment at a local rally sparked her interest in racing. The inherent risks and complex logistics of motorsport, combined with her meticulous nature, led her to transition her skills to the racing world.

At Full Time Sports, Marija is known for her data-driven approach to security. She meticulously analyzes track layouts, crowd flow, and potential vulnerabilities to create comprehensive security plans. She's a firm believer in preventative measures and works closely with local authorities and internal teams to minimize risks. Her dedication to detail and no-nonsense attitude has earned her the respect of her colleagues.

Marija’s sharp intuition and unwavering commitment to safety make her a unique asset. She approaches security as a puzzle to be solved, anticipating threats and implementing solutions with quiet confidence.

physical.hairStyle: Short, layered bob with a slight wave.
physical.description: A stern yet composed woman with a strong, athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down observations.
Insists on conducting security briefings in complete silence, preferring to communicate through visual aids and hand gestures.
Has a habit of polishing her glasses even when they're already clean.
